gradient_measured_fp32_surrogate.note: gradient w.r.t. the exact dequantised stored codes through an FP32 surrogate (the integer path has no autograd); a gradient w.r.t. an INT8 code is that value times scale[row]; not a validated ranking definition

inference_measured.note: 16 threads, CPU, host shared with other jobs

dataset.license: other (GLUE / Stanford Sentiment Treebank); published group read-only until the terms are reviewed

splits.calibration: 512 train records with the smallest sha256('sst2-train-<idx>'), selected by kona_assets.nlp_protocols.sst2_calibration_indices (disjoint from evaluation; the model saw the train split in fine-tuning)
splits.final_evaluation: all 872 validation records, in file order
splits.test: 1821 records with withheld labels (-1): never evaluated

float_arithmetic: token and position embeddings (lookup tables, stored in the source dtype, not quantised)
LayerNorm / RMSNorm (FP32 arithmetic on the source parameters)
attention score and context matrix products QK^T and PV (FP32 eager attention) and softmax
rotary embeddings, activation functions (GELU, SiLU), residual additions (FP32)
Linear biases (FP32, stored as in the source)
dequantisation multiplications and the final log-softmax / cross-entropy (FP32 / FP64 in the evaluation harness)
eligible_stored_int8_population.integer_arithmetic_modules: all 38 Linear layers listed in the manifest
outside_population: biases and all unquantised tensors (embeddings, normalisation parameters)

artifact.kind: W8A8-derived executable: INT8 stored weights with per-token dynamic INT8 activations and exact INT32 accumulation in Linear layers only. Not an unmodified pretrained INT8 checkpoint and not an integer-only network.

precision.derived: W8A8-derived INT8 executable (INT8 Linear weights, per-token dynamic INT8 activations, exact INT32 accumulation); not an unmodified pretrained INT8 checkpoint, not integer-only

activation_rule.granularity: per token (row of the flattened [tokens, in_features] input), dynamic, computed at run time, never stored
activation_rule.rounding: round half to even of the float32 quotient x / a, then clip to [-127, 127], int8

floating_point: token and position embeddings (lookup tables, stored in the source dtype, not quantised)
LayerNorm / RMSNorm (FP32 arithmetic on the source parameters)
attention score and context matrix products QK^T and PV (FP32 eager attention) and softmax
rotary embeddings, activation functions (GELU, SiLU), residual additions (FP32)
Linear biases (FP32, stored as in the source)
dequantisation multiplications and the final log-softmax / cross-entropy (FP32 / FP64 in the evaluation harness)
arithmetic.integer_modules: every nn.Linear of the model, including the language-model head / classifier head (see the per-tensor list)

integer_accumulation.dequantisation: y[t, i] = (float32(acc[t, i]) * a[t]) * scale[i], evaluated left to right in float32, then + bias[i] in float32 if the layer has a bias
integer_accumulation.product: acc[t, i] = sum_j int32(xq[t, j]) * int32(q[i, j]) computed exactly in int32 by torch._int_mm (no saturation; the largest possible magnitude 128*128*3072 is far below 2**31)
integer_accumulation.requantisation: none: the output of every Linear is FP32; the next Linear quantises its own input again (the network is not integer-only)

quantization.per_tensor_identities: quantization_manifest.json (source tensor sha256, qweight sha256, scale sha256, shape, channel axis, rounding, clipping per tensor)

weight_rule.clipping: [-127, 127]; the code -128 is never produced by the quantiser and can only appear through a stored-bit mutation
weight_rule.encoding: int8, two's complement, row-major (C order) [out_features, in_features]
weight_rule.granularity: per output channel (one scale per row of the [out_features, in_features] weight, channel axis 0)
weight_rule.rounding: round half to even (IEEE roundTiesToEven: torch.round / numpy.rint) of the float32 quotient w / scale
weight_rule.scale: float32, scale[i] = max(max_j |w[i, j]| / 127, 1e-12), evaluated in float32
weight_rule.source_values: the source tensor converted to float32 (exact for float32 and bfloat16 sources)

comparison_with_source_precision.gate: accuracy within 1 percentage point of the FP32 reference

reference_results.computation_dtype: W8A8: int8 Linear matmuls (torch._int_mm, exact int32 accumulation, per-token dynamic activation scales); float32 for everything else
reference_results.evaluation_scope: full pinned cohort (not a partial probe)

restrictions: Gradients: torch._int_mm has no autograd; a gradient is available only through an FP32 surrogate with the dequantised stored codes (cost measured, definition is NetSuRF's).
Not a pretrained INT8 checkpoint: results are specific to this recipe (max-abs scales, per-token dynamic activations).
Do not mix with the FP32/BF16 targets of the same family when reporting loss against BER.
The reference model was fine-tuned on the SST-2 train split; evaluation uses the 872 labelled validation records.
